code:
import pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
B=pd.read_csv("basic_patch_scores.csv")
# The previous figure's title overstated this result: the Pgk1 control scores highest,
# so the metric does not identify PX pockets. Overwrite the stale image with an accurate one.
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5,4))
c=["#c0392b" if "Nvj3" in r else ("#2471a3" if ("PX" in r or "Snx3" in r) else "#7f8c8d") for r in B["region"]]
ax.barh(B["region"], B["basic_res_in_best_sphere"], color=c)
ax.set_xlabel("basic residues (R/K/H) clustered within one 8 A sphere")
ax.set_title("Negative control: simple basic-residue clustering does not identify PX pockets\n(Pgk1, which binds no phosphoinositide, scores highest; test is uninformative)", fontsize=10)
ax.grid(axis="x", alpha=0.3); plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("plot_7.png", dpi=110)
plt.show()
print(B[["region","basic_res_in_best_sphere"]].to_string(index=False))
